description: This file implements the connection logic between Chromium DevTools Protocol (CDP) and Browser Bidi (BiDi) protocol, including classes for transport and connection management, and a function to establish a BiDi over CDP connection.

classes.name: BidiTransportImpl
classes.description: Implements the BidiTransport interface for message handling between BiDi and CDP.

classes.name: BidiConnection
classes.description: Manages the BiDi connection, including sending messages and handling close events.

classes.name: CdpTransportImpl
classes.description: Implements the Transport interface for communication over CDP, handling message serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: connectBidiOverCdp
methods.description: Establishes a BiDi connection over a given CDP transport, setting up necessary classes and server.

methods.name: setOnMessage
methods.description: Sets the message handler for BidiTransportImpl.

methods.name: setOnMessage
methods.description: Sets the message handler for CdpTransportImpl.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message string via CdpTransportImpl.
